policy.purpose: Economic consistency and evidence review; findings never edit model assumptions.
policy.thresholdBasis: Broad house triage bands, not empirical market limits or price targets. Deviations request investigation.
policy.peerScope: Research GPU operators only, with matched modeled earning IT MW; landlord NOI and holding-company assets are separate.
policy.quarterBasis: Annualized quarter revenue = quarter revenue × 4. Earning IT MW is the model-effective billable capacity used for that quarter; it is not a separately observed December exit capacity. Ramp fractions are quarter-step approximations.
policy.independentEvidence: A recomputation from the same inputs establishes arithmetic consistency only. Independent fleet, realized price, acceptance and funding evidence remain coverage gaps.
policy.fundingScope: Quarterly cash and dilution for research names; static claims and planned issuance for other names. Funding feasibility is not established by an automatically balanced waterfall.
policy.units: Capacity MW; revenue and asset-model claims USD millions; research funding USD billions; shares millions; valuation USD per share.
policy.scenarios: Illustrative house sensitivities using the canonical calculators; alternatives are not recommendations and are never applied automatically.

cadence.numerical: After relevant data, model and shared quote changes; nightly backstop
cadence.evidence: External evidence research is a separate review; this numerical run does not claim new source verification
